verdict: Paid social is punching above its weight; reviews are stacking. Fix pixel tracking and Spanish-language coverage.
diagnosis: Instagram ads delivered 298 leads at roughly $27 each this period — well below the $180 Meta legal benchmark.

signals.headline: 298 leads at $26.56 each
signals.detail: Spent $7,915 on Instagram lead ads this period. Volume is healthy for a consumer debt practice.

signals.headline: Pixel undercounts leads by 23%
signals.detail: Platform reports 298 leads, pixel only 230. Tracking gap hides real performance from optimization.

signals.headline: 74 new 5-star reviews landed
signals.detail: Total review count reached 755 at a perfect 5.0 average. Strongest trust signal in the file.

signals.headline: 1,521 landing page views, 193 site clicks
signals.detail: Website engagement is thin outside the lead form. Most traffic never leaves the ad experience.

signals.headline: 132 call clicks from Google
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove real phone intent. No direction requests suggests clients prefer remote intake.

recommendations.title: Fix the Meta pixel gap before scaling spend
recommendations.detail: The pixel is missing 68 of 298 leads. Consider a technical audit so Meta's algorithm optimizes on complete data before you increase budget.

recommendations.title: Test a Spanish-language ad set for debt harassment
recommendations.detail: Search data shows Spanish queries like "derechos del consumidor." Worth testing a dedicated Spanish creative and form given the low current cost per lead.

recommendations.title: Route the 74 new reviews into ad creative
recommendations.detail: Reviews at 5.0 average are underused. Consider testing a static ad featuring a real review quote against the current top performer.
